# Your first real analysis

No code in this part. Not one line.

The tools in these chapters are the ones working biologists reach for most
days. They run in a browser, and people publish papers on the strength of them.
You can do real work before you can program, and doing it first means that when
the code arrives in Part 2 you'll already know what you want it to do.

By the end of this part you'll have looked up a gene, identified an unknown
sequence, judged how much to believe the result, and found a protein structure
that nobody has ever seen under a microscope.
